evals.name: prd-only-routes-to-prd-review
evals.prompt: Can you review my app idea? Here's what I've written so far.
expected_behavior: Notices that a PRD exists and no app is built, and asks about the app only if the files leave it unclear
Recommends prd-review first and says the other reviews need something built
Asks before starting, and on a yes runs prd-review from its first step
Judges nothing itself and writes no findings

evals.name: built-app-recommends-order
expected_behavior: Looks for a PRD in the files before asking, and asks only about what it could not find
Recommends an order as a numbered list with one line of reason each, following Step 2's rules
Notes that product-review needs a PRD and does not recommend it while none exists
Starts at most one review, and only after the user agrees

evals.name: named-lens-is-not-routed
evals.prompt: Do an architecture review of this repo.
expected_behavior: No routing questions or recommended order appear before the architecture review starts

evals.name: reports-lens-status
evals.prompt: Where are we with reviews on this project?
files: SUPPLY: a scratch GitHub repo with .app-review.json and open issues across product-review, design-review, and handoff:architecture labels
expected_behavior: Resolves the tracker and lists open entries without exporting, commenting, or closing anything
Reports, per lens, open Blocker and Major counts and handoffs waiting for pickup, and whether the lens is done
Recommends first the lens with handoffs waiting, following Step 2's rules
